title: Merge tool waits only on the required check
why: A browser run dispatched on a PR head no longer holds a merge for up to 240 min.
note: Coordinator 13:10 CST Nov 6, from q_max #1037's reviewer: merge/merge.py wait_checks waits on every pending check on the head. Fix: wait only on all-jobs-passed and name the checks it skipped. It changes the merge tool's wait, so it batches alone, after F1 and F3 with the other guard-file steps. No owner question. Coordinator 21:38 CST: hold lifted after F1 and F3 merged; lane started 21:07 CST.
